evidence: Varr. RR 2.3.9: caprae dispergunt sē (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: caprae dispergunt sē, contrā ovēs sē congregant et condēnsant in locum ūnum
phrases.english: goats scatter, whereas sheep flock together and crowd into one place

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
